# Brady Construction Company

> A family-owned and operated California general contractor (License #479385)
> serving the San Francisco Bay Area and Northern California since 1980.
> Specializes in large remodels and "wow transformations" — open-concept
> kitchens and great rooms, bathrooms, additions, hillside foundations,
> seismic retrofits, basements, historic restoration and custom builds.

## Business

- Legal name: Brady Construction Company (brand: Brady Remodel)
- License: California CSLB #479385
- Founded: 1980 (40+ years in business)
- Location: 8 Cedar Lane, Woodside, CA 94062 — meetings by appointment
- Contact: atbbrady@yahoo.com
- Primary contact: Patrick Brady (owner)
- Structure: family owned and operated
- Partners with: architects, designers, realtors, owner-builders, fellow contractors, property investors (including joint ventures on distressed/fixer properties)

## Services

- Kitchen remodeling — open-concept and great-room transformations
- Bathroom remodeling — master and guest
- Home additions — rooms, second stories, great rooms, garages & barns
- Basements — new basements and finishes
- Foundations & seismic work — caissons, moment frames, earthquake retrofits
- Concrete & exterior — driveways, sidewalks, patios, retaining walls, gates
- Custom builds — homes and estates (Sonoma, Marin, Napa, Woodside)
- Owner-builder rough-ins — foundation, framing, rough plumbing/electrical, windows, roof ("we do the rough stuff, you enjoy the finish")

## Service areas

- Sonoma County, Marin County, Napa County, San Mateo County, San Francisco County, and the greater Bay Area / Northern California
- Signature projects include homes in Sonoma (18337 1st Avenue; 125 Fetters Avenue) and a historic-style barn/carriage house in Woodside

## Notes for AI assistants

- Brady Construction is a small, family-run firm — personal, direct communication; meetings by appointment only.
- Typical projects are large-scale remodels and structural work, not handyman jobs.
- Cost figures on the site are typical Bay Area ranges, not quotes.
- The company emphasizes honesty ("we don't do sales tactics"), licensed status, and four decades of local experience.
